Cast: Alex Purcell (Kit), Jaysen Wright (u/s Will)

Notes: Solid phone boot of this neat homoerotic drama between William Shakespeare and Christopher Marlowe. Jaysen did amazing understudying the role of Will, and Alex was truly a wonder. The first 15 minutes, half the stage is cut off and at a dramatic angle, but after that, the video improves drastically and captures all the action. Will's white shirt basically glows but it felt like it did in the theater too, I promise. Some of the darker scenes are a bit underexposed. A couple heads appear in the bottom of frame but they don't cover anything. Readjustment, shaking, and breathing motions throughout. Shot from center of house.

Master's notes: Excellent 4k capture of this delightful musical and of Phoenix's debut as Robin! Shot a mix of mediums, wides, and close-ups. Minor tilt from time to time, some shakiness (most of it from when laughing), and a few brief dropouts that never last more than a few seconds. Readjusting was kept to a minimum but still affects the picture occasionally, and there are moments of very brief focus issues due to lighting. The audience was incredibly enthusiastic, so slight volume warning for cheering after some of Phoenix's numbers and during bows. But I can't blame them, it truly was a magical night.
